200.description: Where the onboarding stands after the decision.

appliedStep.description: The step whose manual transition was applied; null when none was.

status.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
allOf.title: WorkflowStatus

currentStep.description: The step now awaiting data; null once the onboarding is terminal.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

404.description:
`ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND`: No onboarding has this id.

`WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`: No published workflow has this id, or no revision of it carries the pinned version.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

409.description:
`ONBOARDING_COMPLETED`: The onboarding is already approved or completed and accepts no further moves.

`MANUAL_TRANSITION_NOT_AVAILABLE`: The current step declares no transition for this manual trigger.

`UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW_EVALUATION`: The workflow produced no outcome the engine can apply; the onboarding is left unchanged.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

410.description: `WORKFLOW_RETIRED`: The pinned revision is retired and can no longer be read or run.

500.description: `CLIENT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED`: The client webhook for this move could not be delivered; the outbox entry was returned to pending for the worker to retry.
